children: received a rating upgrade from Stifel, with analyst Brad Reback moving the stock to Buy from Hold and lifting the price target to $575 from $530.

The firm sees room for Microsoft to maintain revenue growth in the mid-to-upper teens. Reback pointed to improving efficiency across Azure, additional data-center capacity and a larger contribution from its OpenAI relationship as factors that could support cloud growth.

Azure remains a key part of the outlook. Microsoft has faced capacity limitations in its cloud business, but Stifel expects new infrastructure and efficiency gains to help the company capture more demand.

The analyst also sees Microsoft 365 as another growth driver. Product improvements could encourage broader adoption of Copilot, while higher GitHub usage may add to revenue growth across the productivity business.
Stifel expects operating margins to remain supported by tighter cost management. Strong cash generation could also reduce the company's reliance on external financing, Reback said.

title: Top Bank Tweaks Microsoft Stock Price Target for 2027
